US–Iran peace by May 31

Polymarket's US–Iran peace deal by May 31 prints at 4%, down from 8% a week ago; the Hormuz blockade-lifting contract fell from 33% to 18% in 48 hours. In the same window Ukraine's SBU destroyed two Tu-142 aircraft and an Iskander system at Taganrog and struck the Feodosiya oil terminal in Crimea. Russia retaliated with 290 drones; air defences claimed 284 kills.

↑ Steelman — escalation

Fresh OFAC designations + a missed deadline + a confirmed deep strike inside Russian infrastructure point to a widening, not a winding-down.

↓ Counterpoint — noise

The May 24 ceasefire was never formally extended but also never broken; markets may be over-reading a procedural lapse as a rupture.
